name: NOAA-20 (JPSS-1)
overpass: about 13:30 local time (about 50 min after Suomi NPP)
modelNote: NASA has not published a NOAA-20 model. NOAA-20 is a nearly identical copy of Suomi NPP (same Ball BCP-2000 design, same instruments plus a Ka-band downlink), so the official Suomi NPP model is shown and labelled.
credit: Model: NASA/Brian E. Kumanchik; NASA/Christian A. Lopez (Suomi NPP)

name: NOAA-21 (JPSS-2)
modelNote: No public 3D model found. NOAA-21 uses a different body (Northrop Grumman LEOStar-3), so the Suomi NPP model would be wrong. Show the card without a model until NASA or NOAA publishes one.
